title: Blast Maze
core_verb: Place a bomb and dodge its cross-shaped blast to break blocks and defeat enemies.
fantasy: A bomber clears a block-filled grid maze of enemies and exits.
fail_state: Your own blast catches you, reducing your single life to zero, or the 120-second timer expires before the exit is reached.
win_state: Defeat every enemy, then step onto the exit tile which opens once the maze is cleared.

interaction_tags.meaning: Hostile on the grid; its health must reach zero to open the exit.
Optional collectible that widens the next bomb's blast by one cell.
The goal tile, unlocked once every enemy is defeated; stepping onto it wins.

notes: The battle mode is reduced to a single-player grid arena: place timed bombs, escape their cross-shaped blasts, break blocks and defeat a finite set of enemies, then exit.

assumptions: A blast propagates along its four arms through breakable blocks, destroying them, and stops at an indestructible wall or its range limit.

scene.description: A top-down grid maze of breakable blocks and indestructible walls, a few enemies patrolling the corridors, and a sealed exit tile in one corner that glows gold once cleared. Power-ups sit in alcoves. Dense: the walls are the visual and the blast carves the routes.
